# Model Coverage Checklist: Harness Diagram

**Purpose**: Check that the spec fully defines what the harness model holds, how it is read, and how it stays true to the repo.
**Created**: 2026-11-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the full list of data files that are elements defined, or is a rule given to find them? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the files of `specs/<feature>/` that become elements named (spec, plan, tasks, changes, decisions, advisor.md, gaps.md)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it defined whether `hooks/ponytail/` helper modules that no event runs directly (config, runtime, map) are elements? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it defined whether `statusline/` data files (`powerline.json`, `themes.json`) are elements? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it defined whether procedures and templates (`procedures/*.md`, `templates/*`) are elements, given that skills follow them? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the advisors (Codex, `/advisor`) and the risk level defined as elements or as link labels? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "passes" told apart from "starts" and "writes" with a definition for each link kind? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "a short plain summary" bounded (1 or 2 sentences) and is its language style named? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it defined how a gate appears in a lane view (a step, a label, or an element)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do the 15 views in SC-006 match the views named in FR-005 and FR-006 (the 4 lanes with their overview and phase or mode views, agents, harness and data flow)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the edit-notes location the same in FR-010 and decision D6? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Is SC-004's "matches a search of the repo" defined with the exact search to compare against? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK013 Can SC-002's 2-minute read be checked by one person without setup? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Is the coverage check's behavior defined for an element whose path is a folder (a skill) and for one that is a file (an agent)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it defined what the test does when `npx` exists but the network is down on the first run? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it defined how a skill that is in no lane appears (only in topic views)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK017 Is the Node version on the laptop confirmed, or is the test's SKIP path enough for it? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the drag-and-save behavior of the pinned version a stated risk with a fallback if it fails the check by hand? [Assumption, Spec §US3]
